descriptions.f11c_tree_find_801d295c: Find an observed unsigned-key/interface-pointer pair in the original ordered tree. Construct a real local8-byte key whose held interface is retained on assignment and released at scope exit; walk the root/left/right links using unsigned lexicographic key and pointer order, validate the lower-bound candidate, use the original header on failure, and copy the resulting native iterator to the caller output. The separate iterator and shared not-found return boundary reproduce the original stack lifetime and assignment. The unused second argument is preserved for the original ABI. Interface,24-byte node, key and tree layouts are partial observed views; names, ownership roles and comparator semantics are inferred, and no complete external class size or constructor implementation is claimed.
